flashcards.definition: Xavier Bichat (defined 21 tissue types without microscopic aid).
Marcello Malpighi (pioneered systematic microscopic analysis of animal tissues).
Coined by Mayer in 1819 to designate the microscopic study of tissue architecture.

flashcards.term: First Phylum with Tissue Level Organization

flashcards.definition: Cell -> Tissue -> Organ -> Organ System -> Organism.
Epithelial, Connective, Muscular, and Nervous Tissue.
Derived from all 3 germ layers: Ectoderm (skin), Mesoderm (endothelium), Endoderm (gut lining).

flashcards.term: Germ Layer Origins of Connective & Muscle Tissues

flashcards.definition: Non-cellular sheet comprising Basal Lamina (epithelial origin) + Reticular Lamina (connective tissue origin).
Lacks direct blood vessels; receives oxygen and nutrients via diffusion from underlying connective tissue capillaries.
Physical protection, barrier against pathogens, prevention of fluid loss, selective absorption, and secretion.
Tightly packed cells held by junctional complexes with minimal intercellular matrix.
